description: This Java source file defines an immutable class named ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder that implements placeholder resolution for policy IDs within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to retrieve its prefix and resolve placeholders given a PolicyId object, likely replacing tokens like 'policy:id', 'policy:namespace', or 'policy:name'.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that provides placeholder resolution for policy identifiers.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string used for placeholders, which is 'policy'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder for the given policy ID, returning an Optional containing the replacement string if successful.
